segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally describe the serum as absorbing without greasiness, though one oily-skin reviewer found it unsuitable, leaving skin tacky and requiring a morning wash.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin most consistently report relief from flaking and dry patches and describe the texture as light rather than heavy, though a few dry-skinned users report the opposite, with new flaking or peeling after use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as lightweight, non-greasy and helpful for makeup application, with one reporting bumps on the cheeks after a few uses.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers largely report no irritation and good hydration, but several specifically flag the fragrance as stinging around the eyes or causing concern about barrier damage.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 50 report visible plumping, softness and a reduction in the appearance of lines with continued use.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying as normal-to-dry reports soft, smooth skin and some reduction in redness when used with the rest of the line.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report firmer, plumper, less lined-looking skin over days to a week of use; no reviewer reports worsened signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report a clear improvement in hydration and disappearance of dry patches, including reviewers with eczema and post-illness dry skin; a minority report worsened dryness, flaking or peeling instead.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the serum helped reduce redness in the cheeks as part of the full Hydro Boost routine; another reports her acne spots turn very red after application, unsure if caused by the product or by rubbing it in.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin warns that the fragrance in the formula can compromise the skin barrier; another reports the product helped a benzoyl-peroxide burn/rash heal faster.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports dry patches around the mouth and chin clearing up; a different reviewer developed small bumps on the upper cheeks after two uses.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and continued use specifically because it does not trigger blemishes; one reviewer reports the fragrance combined with a related Hydro Boost moisturizer made her break out.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination reviewers frequently report the product does not add oiliness or shine and sits well under makeup; one reviewer found it left a tacky residue and required washing off in the morning to avoid feeling greasy.

extraits.texte: I am an African American women with combo skin. It's in the middle of winter and I've heard great things about this serum along with the moisturizer so I gave it a try. At first I used the moisturizer by itself before adding the serum with it. That was a mistake. Each night I used this, I noticed my cheeks started to get dry but I thought it was because of the sudden climate changes and the cold weather. But I was wrong. I tried it for four days straight and each time this serum made my skin more and more dry on my cheeks. It was to the point where it was peeling and looked like I ate powdered sugar and dead skin was in little tiny patches. Kind of like creped skin. As it turns out this serum has benzyl alcohol in it, which is pretty bad. My skin basically malfunctioned and as soon as I exfoliated the dead skin off that accumulated because of the serum and used another hydrating serum (by Botanics) my skin felt 1000% better. I will be throwing this away (if I don't find the receipt). I would never recommend this specific product to anyone. The moisturizer I'll be keeping though.
